_note: Axon's hook-wiring delta over what LifeOS ships. Merged into <configRoot>/settings.json by tools/lifeos-sync, matched on the command string so a re-run is a no-op. <configRoot> in the command strings is substituted by lifeos-sync at deploy time (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, or the literal $HOME/.claude on a default install) — never hardcode the harness root here. LifeOS' own installer only ever ADDS absent keys, so it will never place these itself and never remove them either — this file is the record of why they are there.

PostToolUse._why: LifeOS ships PostToolObserver but wires nothing to it, so LoopDetector (exact-repeat / oscillation / hammering detection) never ran. AlgorithmNudge was registered on PostToolUseFailure only, though its own header declares three events. Matcher-less = catchall, same shape as the EventLogger entry LifeOS ships. Sync, not async: it emits additionalContext.

UserPromptSubmit._why: AlgorithmNudge's routing match + mid-run principal nudge, and DriftReminder's voice-drift nudge. DriftReminder reads the Stop-hook LastResponseCache, so it must run after MemoryTurnStart, which LifeOS already registers first.
